historical_evaluation_usage: Independent500-v2 was previously used as a first blind human evaluation package.
Round1 and DianJin post-hoc reports remain historical records and are not modified by this run.
The historical 85.6% result must not be re-used as a new independent score after development tuning.
development_set.development_reason: The labels are now known and have been used for retrospective analysis; the set is therefore registered as development data for six-dimensional rubric and calibration work, not as future unseen test data.
forbidden_uses: calling the set unseen independent test data again
calling the set a first blind test again
using it as a future model's final official test set
citing the historical 85.6% result as a new independent score after tuning

label_contract.support: Closed-track independent evidence aligns on subject, event, and time and directly supports the core claim.
label_contract.contradict: Closed-track authoritative or multiple independent evidence directly negates the core claim; lack of support is not contradiction.
label_contract.insufficient: Evidence available at publication time is not enough to support or refute the core claim.
label_contract.unclear: Subject, event, metric, time, or evidence direction is conflicted or ambiguous.
